name: kingdom
description: Multi-agent orchestration kit for Claude Code — parallel AI coding with Git worktrees and native cmux.app. A King (👑 Opus) coordinates generic workers (👷), co-workers (🧑‍💼), and watchmen (🕵️) — each in its own cmux.app workspace. Calibrated philosophy: 60% conservative core + 40% industrial overlay. Mandatory exhaustive pattern grep before any implementation (lazy-implementor antidote) — workers use unlimited sub-agent capacity to discover existing project conventions before inventing new approaches. Kingdom branch is a WORKING-TREE OVERLAY for review (never commit on kingdom). PRs carve from worker-N tip byte-for-byte. Two-tier gate: light typecheck per-lane + heavy tests on kingdom overlay. King reads ALL context at session start; uses watchman outputs at every decision point; auto-fires the gate; ALWAYS overlays into kingdom for review BEFORE asking 'push?'. Every per-task artifact carries the lane name. Workers are interchangeable capacity. Domain-agnostic: code, research, finance, science, manuscripts. Bootstrap with /kingdom:init; spawn with /kingdom:start; audit with /kingdom:update; close with /kingdom:exit. Won't touch your project files, develop/main branches, shell config, or git config.
